clips.title: The story
paras: Kargal Battlescar sends the Signed Recruitment Letter west from the Far Watch Post. His mark directs new recruits to report for duty at the Crossroads.

At the Far Watch Post, Kargal Battlescar prepares recruits for service in the Barrens. The post stands east of the Southfury River, where newcomers cross from Durotar. When a conscript proves ready to Kargal, he stamps and signs a letter of introduction. The orders send recruits west along the road to the Crossroads. There, Sergra Darkthorn coordinates supplies and the defense of the dry plains.

Kargal's orders carry his personal contempt for the officer who awaits the recruit. He calls Sergra Darkthorn an abrasive shaman who talks in circles around soldiers. Kargal openly questions Warchief Thrall's high opinion of her. Even so, the dispatch must reach Sergra's hands before any further assignments at the Crossroads are granted.
